blocks.title: Search algorithm
blocks.text: Search algorithms dataset mein khaas cheezein, ya cheezon ke majmooe, dhoondte hain. Yeh maloomat nikalne, database queries aur faisla sazi ke liye zaroori hain.

blocks.prompt: Search algorithms ke do rozmarra istemal bataiye.
blocks.explanation: Phone mein contact dhoondna aur database mein record talash karna (ya search engine se page).

items: Search algorithms data mein cheezein dhoondte hain: maloomat, database queries, faisle.
